chunks: For whom the ordained place is surely Hell,
ai.seo_question: What is the destined destination for the disbelievers according to this verse?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Baqarah, this verse serves as the concluding verdict for the hypocrites (Munafiqun) and disbelievers, affirming that Hell is their inevitable and collective destination. Shia exegesis highlights the certainty ('Laum') of this decree, underscoring that it is not merely a possibility but a fixed reality for those who reject divine guidance.
